title: Historical legacy-Pages race: current HTML beside 15 October plain JSON (23 October)
summary: At 09:53:43Z the plain public executive summary, data/latest.json and data/origination.json agreed on the 09:23:57Z snapshot (30 active fixtures and 30 picks). PR #214 then merged at 09:54:27Z. The interim artifact deployment completed at 09:54:56Z, but that commit's legacy Pages build completed later, at 09:55:18Z. At 10:00:08Z the plain HTML still carried the 09:23:57Z snapshot while both plain JSON files had regressed to the checked-in 15 October fixtures. A later merge at 10:17:37Z produced another legacy build that landed at 10:19:09Z during verification of a 10:18:15Z artifact deployment, and that publisher run failed with stale public HTML. This incident is retained after recovery; it is not a current-picks claim.

timeline.event: Independent plain-URL audit passed on the 09:23:57Z snapshot: 30 active fixtures, 30 directional picks, 22 external-line rows, 8 research-model rows and 0 unresolved.
PR #214 merged to main at eeae869, starting both the legacy Pages build and the Refresh and deploy workflow.
The republish-last-verified job completed its interim artifact deployment.
The same commit's legacy Pages build completed after the interim artifact deployment.
Plain public HTML and plain public JSON disagreed: HTML 2026-10-23T09:23:57Z, latest.json 2026-10-15T08:36:13Z, origination.json 2026-10-15T09:31:24Z.
Another main commit, 90e347d, started a further legacy Pages build while the 09:54 publisher was still building its fresh snapshot.
The 09:54 publisher deployed its fresh artifact.
The 90e347d legacy Pages build completed during the artifact verification window.
Publisher run 39935261830 failed public verification with wrong or stale dashboard HTML.

A later publisher root-sync commit, ab12bf6, published rendered HTML for the 10:43:14Z snapshot; PR #222 merged 11 seconds later, illustrating why deployment ordering must resolve the latest main commit rather than only the workflow's starting SHA.
